cues: Database design converts the ER diagram into tables with three rules.
A one to many relationship puts the key of the one side into the many table as a foreign key.
And a many to many relationship becomes a new table, keyed by the pair of foreign keys: student enrols in course.
text: Database design converts the ER diagram into tables with three rules. Every entity becomes a table. A one to many relationship puts the key of the one side into the many table as a foreign key. And a many to many relationship becomes a new table, keyed by the pair of foreign keys: student enrols in course.
